name: Connecticut
summary: The Connecticut Makerspace Network — the makerspaces, hackerspaces, fab labs, and shared workshops of Connecticut, and the shared standards and data they maintain together.

steward.note: Regional steward model, after Nation of Makers' Regional Champions. A region without a named steward goes stale — see docs/INTEROP.md §1.

grouping.$comment: Counties are how Connecticut residents locate things, but county alone is a weak filter — capability and access model do the real work in the directory UI.
